requirement.description: The rlp_encode function signature doesn't match test expectations. Tests call rlp_encode with str_mode parameter but the current implementation doesn't accept this parameter. Additionally, the function raises an exception when the 'rlp' package isn't installed, but tests expect it to work without requiring this dependency.
requirement.contract: Modify the rlp_encode function to accept an optional str_mode parameter with default value None. Implement fallback logic to handle encoding without requiring the external 'rlp' package when str_mode is provided.

requirement.description: The rlp_decode function requires the 'rlp' package to be installed, but tests fail because this dependency is missing. Tests expect it to work with different types of decoding (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex).
requirement.contract: Modify the rlp_decode function to support different decoding types without requiring the 'rlp' package. Implement fallback logic to handle decoding for different input types.

requirement.description: Missing cryptographic functions that are referenced in tests but not implemented in the binary module. Functions like private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key, and pack_vrs are missing from the module.
requirement.contract: Add the missing cryptographic functions to the binary module. These include: private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key, and pack_vrs.

requirement.description: Missing rlp_encode CLI command that is referenced in tests but not implemented. Tests expect this command to be available via CLI but it's not found in the compute commands directory.
requirement.contract: Implement the rlp_encode CLI command in the compute commands directory and ensure it's properly registered in the CLI command index.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode function signature doesn't properly support the str_mode parameter that tests expect. Tests are calling it with str_mode='text' but the function signature doesn't match.
requirement.contract: Update the rlp_encode function signature to properly support str_mode parameter and implement expected behavior for different modes when the rlp package is not available.
